title: [Shopify] Preserve manually set Sell-to Customer No. when Bill-to mapping fails
summary: Fixed a Shopify Connector bug where manually set Sell-to Customer No. was overwritten when Bill-to Customer No. failed to map, and added fallback logic to derive Bill-to from Sell-to when unmapped.
key_points: Sell-to Customer No. mapping now runs only when Sell-to is blank, so a manually chosen customer is kept
Bill-to Customer No. falls back to Sell-to Customer No. when it would otherwise stay blank
Automated imports, where Sell-to starts blank, behave as before
Only the non-B2B mapping path changed; B2B mapping is untouched
Test added for a manual Sell-to with an unmapped Bill-to
